consultants.work_report_market_feedback:
Louis Daily Work Report
Date: 2026.8.17
Location: India Chandigarh 
System/Platform Served:
GDC community (India Market)

Community Leader:
Sanjeev & Natin

Number of Invited Participants: 30
New Sales Performance:- (Philippines)
AiaxChat Downloads: -

Work Activities:
-Today the Ivy training program meeting was held in Chandigarh, India by Frank and I. The meeting was delayed due to the late arrival of the leadership team. Ultimately, about 30 people attended.
-Today, Frank presented the mechanism, and I explained On-chain queries. The meeting venue was in a bit rural location with poor internet connectivity, which caused considerable inconvenience.

Although the meeting was somewhat chaotic today, the overall process went smoothly. Everyone was very proactive and friendly, with interactive Q&A sessions. 
-However, since most participants had previously been involved in Olympus DAO-type projects and had suffered losses, they were somewhat cautious. Most of the questions revolved around comparisons with CDao mechanism changed, and how to make sure same issues won't happen in X-Dao, how to showcase we are different compare with Cdao, we provided appropriate responses.

Market Feedback Issues:
The recent situation with CDao has caused widespread unease here. Due to the similarity in mechanisms, people keep comparing it to XDao. Although we provided explanations, participants remain relatively conservative because of their past negative experiences.

Summary:
Today's Ivy League meeting was held. All attendees had previously participated in Olympus DAO and had experienced losses. Most compared the project to CDao. Currently, the sentiment here is relatively conservative, and performance/progress is expected to be slow. Follow-up efforts will be needed.

Upcoming schedule:
23th Aug India Delhi Ivy
24th Aug India Delhi Ivy
26th Aug India Pune Ivy

consultants.name: Raymond
consultants.work_report_market_feedback:
工作日志：Raymond
日期：2026年8月17日
地点： 越南（胡志明市）

服务系统及社区： 阿明系统（123社区）
社区领导人： 阿明、李总、杨思
邀约人数： 2人
新增业绩： 待统计
AIAX Chat下载： 待统计

一、今日执行与行动

跟进123社区从国内抵达胡志明市的李总、杨思，约了今天上午11点进行线下会面沟通。两位领导目前主要寻找新的项目及市场机会，对X-Dao完成初步了解后整体反馈较为积极。
结合两位领导的团队及市场方向意向，了解到他们之前是做杭州的市场的，这次出来主打国际市场，在韩国也有自己的小团体。其现阶段主要布局韩国市场，未来两天将配合开展课程学习及项目分享，为后续韩国市场推进做好准备。跟他们聊了很久直到下午3点多，再回阿明的办公室，跟他沟通接下来几天我的工作行程安排，需要他们这边团队做到更多的裂变和发展，暂时接下来我会去新加坡市场协助。
同步筹备后续新加坡市场对接工作，计划近期前往当地与欧阳先生进行市场交流，目前机票及酒店已完成安排，行程准备基本到位。

二、市场问题反馈

李总、杨思目前对X-Dao处于初步认可阶段，后续需通过持续培训及实际交流进一步深化认知。
两位领导核心市场在韩国，后续项目推进需结合当地团队及市场资源进一步评估。

三、总结

今日重点完成123社区两位外部团队领导的初步接洽，目前对X-Dao反馈积极，后续将通过持续培训进一步建立项目认知，并配合其韩国市场资源推进落地。同时新加坡市场行程已基本准备完成，整体海外市场工作持续推进中。
